basic_profile.bio: An avid Clash of Clans player who loves to strategize and upgrade their base. Originally from the Midwest, now living in a bustling city, they spend their weekdays working as a systems analyst. In their free time, they enjoy pickling various foods and watching science fiction series, especially anything related to Star Trek. They're currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore new hobbies and interests. Typically online in the evenings after work or during the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in gaming strategies through extensive play and participation in online forums. Additionally, has a strong interest in technology and Linux systems, using HiveOS for cryptocurrency mining as a hobby.
